agent_skill.conflict_sub: This novel already has a skill with call name "{call_name}"
agent_skill.conflict_note: Overwrite replaces the target record and drops the old source link. Rename keeps two independent installations and never breaks the new skill's upgrade association.
agent_skill.library_conflict_sub: A library skill named "{name}" already exists.
agent_skill.library_conflict_impact: Overwriting it updates {installations} linked installation(s) across {novels} novel(s).
agent_skill.edit_in_library_confirm_mess: Changes to "{name}" will apply to {installations} installation(s) across {novels} novel(s).
agent_skill.delete_library_confirm: Delete "{name}" from the library? This also removes {installations} linked installation(s) across {novels} novel(s).
agent_skill.upgrade_note: Confirming overwrites the snapshot content and source version, keeping the call name, enabled state, and sort order. Existing prose is unaffected.
agent_skill.revoked_note: Local content is preserved. You can inspect it or save it to the library, but runtime skips execution until you install a non-revoked version.
agent_skill.mine_unavailable_text: Once the marketplace is connected, you can manage your uploads here.
agent_skill.prompt_hint_setup: Describe the execution steps and output requirements for this skill...
agent_skill.when_to_use_hint: e.g. When writing chapter prose that must stay in character...
agent_skill.when_to_use_help: The model uses this to decide when to load the skill. Prefer concrete situations over vague descriptions.
agent_skill.description_hint: One sentence on what this skill does...
